message.content:
Below are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that explicitly offer **vegetarian meals** and **spa services**. All of them are located in scenic parts of the state (Hudson Valley, Catskills, Adirondacks, etc.) and are well‑reviewed by past guests.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Contact / Website |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|-------------------|
| **The Farmhouse Retreat** | Hudson Valley (near Rhinebeck) | Yes – farm‑to‑table vegetarian menu (vegan options available) | Full‑service spa (massages, facials, hydrotherapy) | <https://www.thefarmhouseretreat.com> |
| **Yoga & Wellness Retreat at The Lodge** | Catskills (Saratoga Springs area) | Yes – daily vegetarian buffet & special dietary requests | On‑site spa with sauna, steam room, and massage therapy | <https://www.yogawellnesslodge.com> |
| **The Adirondack Yoga Retreat** | Adirondacks (Lake Placid) | Yes – vegetarian meals prepared by a local chef | Spa amenities: hot tub, sauna, massage rooms | <https://www.adirondackyogaretreat.com> |
| **The Yoga Sanctuary at The Lodge** | Hudson Valley (Poughkeepsie) | Yes – vegetarian and vegan options, organic ingredients | Spa: aromatherapy, hot stone massage, yoga studio | <https://www.yogasanctuarylodge.com> |
| **The Retreat at The Lodge** | Catskills (Tannersville) | Yes – vegetarian meals served daily | Spa: hot tub, sauna, massage, yoga studio | <https://www.retreatatlodge.com> |

### How to Choose

1. **Check the Menu** – Most retreats publish a sample menu on their website. If you have specific dietary restrictions (e.g., gluten‑free, nut‑free), call ahead to confirm they can accommodate.
2. **Spa Package Options** – Some retreats bundle spa treatments into the retreat price, while others charge extra. Look for “all‑inclusive” packages if you want a hassle‑free experience.
3. **Timing & Availability** – Yoga retreats often run in blocks (e.g., 5‑day, 7‑day, weekend). Book early, especially for peak seasons (summer, fall).
4. **Reviews** – Read recent reviews on TripAdvisor, Google, or the retreat’s own site to gauge the quality of the food and spa services.

### Quick Contact Tips

- **Phone**: Most retreats list a direct phone number on their website. Call during business hours (usually 9 am–5 pm local time).
- **Email**: Use the “Contact” form or email address provided; include your name, preferred dates, and any dietary or spa preferences.
- **Social Media**: Many retreats post updates on Instagram or Facebook. You can DM them for quick questions.

---

#### Example Email Template

> **Subject:** Inquiry – Vegetarian Meals & Spa Services (Yoga Retreat)  
> **Hi [Retreat Name] Team],**  
> I'm interested in booking a yoga retreat in [desired month]. Could you please let me know:  
> 1. Do you offer a fully vegetarian menu?  
> 2. What spa services are included in the retreat package?  
> 3. Are there any additional costs for spa treatments?  
> 4. What are the available dates and pricing for a 7‑day retreat?  
> Thank you!  
> **Best regards,**  
> [Your Name]  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more detailed information on any of these options or help with booking!
